reviewContext.issueReference: none (no GitHub issue); opus-terra-design-and-implement-review-loop-session-868; source of truth is the workflow requestedOutcome, design-docs/specs/design-ai-capture.md revision 4 and impl-plans/active/capture-*.md
reviewContext.userProblem: Finish the nodetto AI capture feature on feat/ai-capture: capture the current page as PNG or JPG for every page kind; for a 3D CAD page from a chosen camera with interference between bodies visible in the image and reported as text, so an AI agent can capture its own work and feed back on it. M10 (be8fa5d) is unreviewed and is repaired; M20, M22, M15, M17, M18, M11, M12, M14, M23 and M16 remain.
requiredOutcomes: M10 repaired and sound: interference between distinct bodies detected within the stated cell and ray budget, shared tool views, streamed level 0, total inputs, tool_view seam and wave-2 stub modules, with tests (design 6.6, 18 CAP-R4-01/02, CAP-DR4-01/02).

nodetto-cli capture on a 3D CAD page reports interference as text (bodies, where, how much), has the options and exit code of M20, and draws the interfering region as a hatched overlay agreeing with the text (M17, M22, M23).

Body states and sampled emptied-body errors are reported (M18); imported meshes, open meshes and translucent reference bodies render (M11, M23); the large-page work limit and budget hold and are measured (M12, M23).
The desktop app offers the capture for the current page through a Tauri command, export backend method and Export dialog entry, including JPG for 2D artwork, in light and dark themes (M14, M15).

Docs and CLI help let an agent discover capture unprompted; measured budgets recorded in the design; progress table marks every milestone accepted; mise run verify, nodetto-native tests and CLI native parity pass on the final tree (M16).
Existing export behaviour and documents keep working; captures stay deterministic; all commits local on feat/ai-capture.
nonGoals: Redoing accepted milestones M1-M9, M19, M13.
cad3d M21 (PCB board tool) and cad3d M18 (wireframe export and docs); edits of cad3d design or plan files; README.md edits.
Design sections 2.3 and 2.4; any nodetto-cloud, server, auth, secret or deployment code.
Changing refinement priority, budgets or JSON reply keys of the interference analysis.
constraints: Workers edit only their writePaths, their own plan file Progress section and their evidence directories (tmp/capture/<mNN> named in the plan and tmp/capture-s868/<planId>). No git state changes, no stash, branches or worktrees, never push.

English only, no emojis, strict TypeScript without any; cargo with CARGO_TERM_QUIET=true and a per-plan CARGO_TARGET_DIR=target/capture-<mNN>; format only owned files (rustfmt --edition 2021 <files>, bunx biome format --write <files>).
crates/capture: forbid(unsafe_code), no panic on any input, only + - * / and sqrt on geometry, dependencies only png and jpeg-encoder. Heavy or timed tests are release only.

Boa-run code (packages/core, apps/cli/src, packages/io): no whole-document regex, no per-point allocation in geometry loops, no deep recursion. packages/core never imports @nodetto/io, DOM, Node or the kernel.
Existing tests and deadlines are never weakened except the exact pre-authorised changes named in each plan; timing tests may be retried up to three attempts, then run in isolation, all logged.
Third-party code is reference only; own fixtures with neutral names; new dependencies need compatible licences recorded in THIRD_PARTY_NOTICES.md; theme tokens only, dark theme supported.
A failure located only in a same-wave sibling's file is logged and re-run after the sibling lands; never edit the sibling's file.

designDecisionsAndRationale.decision: Revision 4 stage order: wave 1 M10, M20, M22, M15; wave 2 M17, M18, M11, M12, M14; wiring M23; closing M16 (design 8.5).
designDecisionsAndRationale.rationale: Requested maximum concurrency with at most two waves before wiring; dependencies only on real contracts; one final wiring plan owns the shared registration files (lib.rs, raster.rs, shade.rs, report.rs, capture-cad.ts, capture-command.ts, native-parity/capture.test.ts).

designDecisionsAndRationale.rationale: Overview write-ownership table; dependsOn edges enforce the order, so no file has two writers within a stage.

designDecisionsAndRationale.decision: Amendment 2026-11-23 round 1: checkpoint amendment for integration-paths-outside-writePaths (INT-MESH-BOUNDS-SEAM, INT-M15-VERIFY3-ARTIFACT-ROOT). capture-11-mesh-reference gains crates/capture/src/lattice.rs and crates/capture/src/interference.rs (tool-bounds call sites only, routed to tool_view::tool_bounds via lattice::scene_tool_bounds) and now depends on capture-17-interference-overlay and capture-18-body-census; the capture-15-desktop-ui and capture-14-desktop-backend desktop build gates write under target/capture-m15/dist and target/capture-m14/dist; the manifest is owned nominally by capture-15-desktop-ui and its worker must not edit it.
designDecisionsAndRationale.rationale: Blocked plans: capture-11-mesh-reference (M10 left the pair, candidate and view-pair tool bounds on loop boxes, so meshes got empty bounds; recorded as design CAP-R4-05) and capture-15-desktop-ui (verification 3 wrote apps/desktop/dist outside artifactRoots). Accepted plans capture-10-interference, capture-20-interference-cli, capture-22-report-text, capture-17-interference-overlay, capture-12-scale-budget and capture-18-body-census keep stable IDs and are not redispatched; capture-18-body-census acceptance stays provisional until integration after M11 and M23.

designDecisionsAndRationale.decision: Amendment 2026-11-23 round 2 (blocked-wave-scope-or-contract): capture-23-wiring gains crates/capture/src/mesh.rs for an additive facet-normal seam only (MeshView surface_intervals, first_surface_hit, surface(facet) -> (0, unit triangle normal)), mirroring PrismView::surface_intervals and surface, plus the matching tool_view.rs dispatch; mesh.rs joins the M23 rustfmt gate; the manifest is now owned nominally by capture-23-wiring and its worker must not edit it.
designDecisionsAndRationale.rationale: Wave 6 blocked capture-23-wiring: MeshView returns face-0 boundaries without the hit triangle or normal (mesh.rs:213, :257), but design 6.5 shades and edges mesh samples with the triangle normal (recorded as design CAP-R4-06). capture-11-mesh-reference is accepted and not redispatched; no other pending plan writes mesh.rs (capture-16-docs-final depends on capture-23-wiring), so the file has one writer. Analysis outputs, census and the M11 tests stay unchanged.

intentionalTradeoffs: Wave-2 crate plans each run clippy over nodetto-capture and wave-1 TS plans run the repo-wide bun run typecheck, so a sibling's half-finished edit can fail a gate temporarily; recorded and re-run after the sibling lands.
M14 adds the nodetto-capture path dependency to the app crate; sibling cargo runs may rewrite Cargo.lock with identical content; M14 records the Cargo.lock hash after its own cargo run.

M23 replaces the render.rs pixel digest and lines 407, 410, 411 of references_meshes_and_interference_stay_out_of_the_m8_picture, and regenerates capture-plate-default.ncs1, exactly as design 8.5 authorises.
M23 verification 2 checks exit 0 and no failed tests without a positive pass-count grep; verification 1 of the same plan runs the crate tests.
supportedEdgeCases: Touching faces and overlaps at or below 0.001 mm are not interference; sub-cell slivers seen in the picture are reported as (found in the picture only).

Capped refinement pairs are marked approximate in text and JSON; unchecked candidates are listed (first twenty) and counted; --fail-on-interference exits 1 for pairs or unchecked candidates, never for capped pairs alone.
More than 4,096 picture-only pairs and scenes above WORK_LIMIT are refused with exact error texts (CLI exit 2).
Bodies emptied by a difference or intersection step report cad.result.empty (sampled); emptied-and-refilled bodies keep their state; sound models cost zero census rays.
Closed meshes are solids; open meshes are drawn translucent and labelled [open mesh, not checked]; PCB reference bodies drawn at 45% and take part in interference.
Invalid lattice inputs (NaN, zero, negative, infinite cell, inverted box) never panic, loop or divide by zero.
Desktop: Current view only when a camera exists; entry disabled outside cad3d pages or without the native backend (Available in the desktop app.); cancelled save writes nothing; dark theme.
outOfScopeEdgeCases: Perspective projection, wireframe capture and PCB board tool behaviour (cad3d M18, M21).
Cloud document capture and server-side rendering (design 14).
Interference between faces of a single body.
